observations: Mirea et al., Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience 2024, report that a persistent latent-cause model with a fixed probability that the previous cause continues explains explicit human latent-cause judgments better than two other time-sensitive alternatives; this supports an explicit temporal persistence prior but does not imply that one fixed hazard is optimal for machine change detection.

Adams and MacKay's Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection computes a posterior over run length from predictive likelihood and a hazard function; a geometric gap prior gives a constant hazard. This run used that structure only as an engineering control, not as a neuroscience claim.

Shappell et al., NeuroImage 2019, motivate hidden semi-Markov modeling of brain-state changes because ordinary HMMs impose geometric sojourn durations; this is relevant to the new boundary found here, where a single persistence/run-length prior conflates temporary latent silence with persistent context change.
A fresh read-only attempt to locate the SPLiT PLOS/Figshare Code.zip through public search again did not yield the binary/source payload; no mutation or write-probe was performed.

design.stream_family: Continuation of the bounded nonlinear low-rank latent-stream controls. Ambient N=24, active rank k=4, persistent representation/task switches plus temporary task-relevant latent silences. Both PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like trackers were evaluated. A stronger rank-collapse variant increased nuisance competition and lengthened temporary silences. This is not a source-exact SPLiT simulation.
design.unsupervised_observation_likelihood: On disjoint mixed calibration streams, form five window-delta features without event labels: tracker reconstruction-residual energy, PCA subspace-angle change, covariance-change rank ratio, covariance trace change, and covariance spectral-entropy change. Robustly scale the pooled deltas and fit a four-component full-covariance Gaussian mixture without switch/silence labels. Select the global-change component structurally as the component with the largest positive residual+subspace-angle+trace mean; select the temporary-silence component structurally as the component with the most negative residual+trace mean.
design.run_length_prior: A bounded Gaussian predictive run-length filter with a constant persistence hazard was combined in odds space with the unsupervised global-change emission likelihood. Hazard 0.008 and release threshold 0.65 were locked on disjoint mixed calibration environments before held-out evaluation.
design.memory_gate: A lost decoder-bearing direction became a provisional dormant-memory candidate from local subspace/energy evidence. An ungated control admitted it directly. A global-change gate suppressed/released memory around inferred persistent changes. A cause-specific gate additionally required recent posterior mass on the unsupervised temporary-silence component. The silence-posterior admission threshold 0.65 was selected on separate strong-rank-collapse calibration streams and frozen before held-out memory evaluation.

interpretation: The multivariate unsupervised cause likelihood is the main improvement. The standalone run-length signal was weak, and adding the fixed-hazard run-length prior generally increased false episodes and substantially reduced detection under strong rank collapse.

The run-length prior slightly improved Brier/ECE only in the easiest low-hazard family; under strong rank-collapse distribution shift it degraded both discrimination and calibration versus the unsupervised cause likelihood alone.

Therefore the source-inspired temporal persistence prior is not promoted as a mechanism benefit in this bounded control. A single fixed persistence/run-length model appears too coarse when temporary latent silence and persistent context change have distinct duration statistics.

Requiring posterior evidence for the temporary-silence cause cut admissions by about an order of magnitude and greatly reduced false admissions, but it also discarded most true silence-return opportunities. The current utility bottleneck is under-admission, not bank capacity.

In moderate feedback, cause-specific gating removed a significant stale-memory post-switch penalty relative to ungated memory, while producing only a tiny post-silence benefit and no resolved overall-MSE gain.

In severe sparse/delayed feedback, ungated memory happened to improve overall MSE on these held-out streams; the conservative cause gate surrendered much of that benefit. This prevents claiming a general task-loss improvement from the new posterior.
The useful positive result is therefore narrower: multivariate cause evidence can suppress memory churn and stale-memory harm. It does not yet solve utility-aware dormant-memory promotion.

limits: Synthetic bounded audit only; not a reproduction of SPLiT, LCNet, Mirea et al., BOCPD, or a biological memory mechanism.

The GMM cause labels are selected from component geometry, not trained with event labels, but the number of components and the detector thresholds were chosen on disjoint synthetic calibration environments.
The run-length filter is a source-derived engineering hybrid rather than an exact implementation of every indexing convention in Adams-MacKay BOCPD.
True/false admission and release labels use synthetic ground-truth event windows for evaluation only and are unavailable to the online mechanism.
The strong rank-collapse stream intentionally stresses subspace competition and is outside the exact prior-run environment distribution.

candidate_update.positive_scope: Five-dimensional covariance/subspace change evidence learned without event labels can distinguish global context changes from temporary latent silences well enough to suppress many stale-memory admissions/releases in bounded streams. A cause-specific admission gate sharply reduces churn and removes a moderate-feedback post-switch harm relative to ungated memory.
candidate_update.negative_boundary: A single fixed-hazard run-length prior does not improve the emission model and is brittle under strong rank collapse. Conservative silence-cause gating misses most true reusable directions and does not establish an overall task-loss gain.

bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Replace the single fixed-hazard run-length prior with an explicit-duration hierarchical latent-state model that separately represents temporary latent silence and persistent context change; use semi-Markov/sojourn distributions rather than one geometric persistence process. Fit duration/emission parameters only on disjoint calibration streams, then lock them for held-out altered switch/silence hazards. Make dormant-memory admission utility-aware: estimate posterior expected future benefit of retaining a direction versus stale-interference cost, not merely P(silence). Compare the explicit-duration model against the strong unsupervised GMM-only likelihood, since the latter is currently the better detector. Preserve both tracker families, moderate/severe feedback, calibration/reliability metrics, admission/release precision-recall, post-silence recovery and post-switch interference. Keep all claims bounded until source-exact SPLiT code is recovered.
